primary_source.cite: Ellmann A., Kaminskis J., Parseliunas E., Jurgensohn H., Oja T. (2009). Evaluation results of the Earth Gravitational Model EGM08 over the Baltic countries. Newton's Bulletin No 4, pp. 110-121
primary_source.points: 189 GNSS-levelling points (EE 26 / LV 53 / LT 110), h in ETRS89 (GRS-80), H in Baltic Height System 1977 (Kronstadt tide-gauge)
primary_source.discrepancy: N_geom - zeta_EGM: range +0.346..+0.697, mean +0.493, STD 0.060 (verified from the PDF, section 5 and Fig. 7 caption)
methodology_verified: EGM08 tide-free version, harmonic_synth_v02 (no zero-degree term)
zero-degree term -0.936 m (GRS80 GM difference) ADDED to zeta (section 3.3)
W0-U0 term EXCLUDED from comparisons; with W0 Ardalan et al. 2002 the term (W0-U0)/gamma = +0.52 m and the Kronstadt datum practically coincides with mean ocean level (section 5)
levelling heights = Baltic Height System 1977 (Kronstadt tide-gauge) (section 5)
primary_source.convention_translation: D_NGA = mean_discrepancy - 0.53, where 0.53 m = difference between the NGA-grid zero-degree convention (-0.41 rel. WGS84) and the article's (-0.936 rel. GRS80); per-country: EE +0.04 / LV -0.05 / LT -0.05 / Baltics -0.03
primary_source.caveats: points 150-400 km from SPb; Estonian subset may carry post-glacial rebound contamination (article section 5); -0.41 m NGA zero-degree value derived, not stated in the article; sigma_D=0.06 is a lower bound - budget 0.10 until SPb points arrive

cross_checks.granite_marks_6.64: confirmed marks on granite quay walls: median dH -0.01 m -> D + eps(granite) ~ -0.01
cross_checks.atayans_all_6.61: +1.08 = surface bias of prior-30m, NOT datum

supplemental_icesat_check.result: median(h_ell_ATL06 - N_EGM2008) over open-gulf water, ice-free months, high-cnf: +0.17 m (MAD 0.25, n=236942); per-year +0.03..+0.30; west +0.12 / east +0.24
supplemental_icesat_check.interpretation: estimate = D + L + b(ATL06 over water); L = modern mean sea level minus BS-77 zero (order -0.1..+0.1), b = ATL06 water-fit bias (order +0.05..+0.2); does not contradict D = 0.00 +/- 0.06
supplemental_icesat_check.status: supplemental; final D needs >= 20 GNSS/levelling points in SPb (B3 request) or ATL13 + tide-gauge series

constant_errors_m.sign_convention: '+' = constant larger than truth -> BS-77 heights come out LOWER than true (flooding slightly overestimated)
